scenario: A technician wearing smart glasses packs a mobile laser scanner (Navvis M6) away into its transport boxes, following an expert's remote guidance.
sop: places the m6 head into the head box.
puts on the last lens cap.
places the m6 batteries into the battery box.
inserts the m6 body into the neck box.
places the m6 wheels and wheel unit into the wheel box.
stacks the head box atop the battery box.
locks the head box and battery box together.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician fitting a lens cap onto an M6 lens, not merely holding a cap near the lens?
questions.why: Caps protect the exposed lenses during transport.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician separating the M6 head from the rest of the scanner, not merely repositioning or handling the assembled scanner?
questions.why: The head must be detached before it can be packed.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician placing the detached M6 head inside the head box, not merely setting it beside or on top of the box?
questions.why: The head needs to be secured in its designated box.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician removing an M6 battery from the scanner, not merely touching or inspecting a battery that remains installed?
questions.why: The batteries must be removed before packing.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician inserting the disassembled M6 body into the neck box, not merely placing the body next to the box?
questions.why: The body has a designated transport box.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician placing the M6 wheels and wheel unit inside the wheel box, not merely handling or setting them beside the box?
questions.why: The wheel components need to be packed together in their box.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician shutting a transport-box lid, not merely placing an open lid on the box without closing it?
questions.why: Closed boxes protect the packed equipment.

questions.ask: Does this video itself show the technician locking the head box to the battery box while the head box is stacked on top, not merely stacking the boxes or handling a latch?
questions.why: The stacked boxes need to be secured together for transport.
